attributes.blockerTitle: Pretui realm has no public read
attributes.detail: The tracker and concept cards import pretui components cross-realm from `richard.tan1/pretui`. That realm requires an authorized session, so a **local render of any pretui consumer fails module resolution** — the matrix-layer mirror in `packages/experiments-realm` can no longer be verified at localhost:4201 for these cards. Verify on staging instead, or grant the pretui realm public read.

cardInfo.name: Pretui realm has no public read
cardInfo.summary: Local render of pretui consumers fails; verify on staging
